notes.maintenance_cycle_227: Catch-up after 7-month gap (364 commits since cycle-226). Found: ontology already contained 6 auth-era terms (User, UserRepository, AuthenticationService, AuthorizationService, InMemoryUserRepository, LoginForm; added upstream ~commit 1b01f07a) but mappings.yml still had only 43 entries and metrics/budget were stale at 43. Fixed: added 6 mappings (all verified against real files; User -> prisma model User; AuthenticationService -> auth API routes), budget current_usage 43->49, metrics re-measured (158 non-test src files, db mappings 3->4, api mappings 6->7). Bloat check: 49/80 terms (61%), 0 drafts, queue empty, 0 unmapped -> HEALTHY. Observation: AuthorizationService carries layer value 'application' (non-standard vs core/domain/aux) — left as-is (minimal diff), flagged as open risk.
notes.maintenance_cycle_228: Schema-conformance fixes from cycle-227 review: (1) AuthorizationService layer normalized 'application' -> 'domain' (ontology layer taxonomy is core/domain/aux per 10_concept_sync_system B-7; domain chosen for symmetry with AuthenticationService and because RBAC role rules are business logic, not aux (GC-first) material); (2) 32 legacy-schema invariants gained required status:'stable' and strength fields (severity CRITICAL/HIGH->hard, MEDIUM->soft, convention verified against the pre-existing 68 entries) — now 79 hard / 21 soft / 100 stable; (3) mappings reference verification: all 174 code_symbols/db refs resolve to real files, all 20 api endpoint refs exist as src/app/api/*/route.ts (stats, seed, export, records, health, metrics, analytics, auth login/logout/session); (4) claims.ndjson re-validated against 10_concept_sync_system C-1: 9/9 lines schema-compliant. Known remaining gap (recorded for next run): all 100 invariants use 'constraint' field instead of schema field 'statement' and lack 'evidence' entries.
